_doc: Hired companions (ruling 31): three kinds, hired at the mercenary hall in town. A mercenary levels with its hero (its level = the hero's), wears the weapon / chest / head its hero gives it, has 3-4 skills of its own, and if it falls it waits in town until revived for gold. One per hero. Numbers multiply the same hero-like baseline as a hero of that level (hp = 70 + 18 x (L-1)). AI (js/sim/allies.js, shared with pets and summons): keeps near its hero, defends first (whatever is hitting its hero), then the hero's target, never stacks, walks round things on the walk grid.

shieldbearer.name: Shield-bearer
shieldbearer.blurb: Stands in front, holds their attention, and takes the hits.

archer.name: Archer
archer.blurb: Shoots from behind you and picks off what you have marked.

hedgemage.name: Hedge-mage
hedgemage.blurb: Throws fire, mends your cuts between fights, and keeps a ward on you.
